verdict.rationale: telli is a SaaS voice-agent platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing about an official command-line tool. Those adjacent programmatic surfaces do not count as a CLI, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
